experiments.name: Selective sharing overhead
experiments.metric: ms (filtered read avg − full read avg, both grant-based)
experiments.detail: n=20 each; full grant-based read avg=69.031ms, Protocol-filtered read avg=66.760ms (both non-self, so neither pays the accessPolicy computation cost — isolates pure field-filtering overhead)

experiments.name: Access revocation time
experiments.detail: revokeAccess call latency; subsequent read returned 403 (expected 403)

experiments.name: Key recovery success rate
experiments.detail: 10/10 valid-threshold reconstructions matched original; 10/10 insufficient-share attempts correctly threw

experiments.name: Selective disclosure payload reduction
experiments.detail: Selective proof (3 attrs + age predicate): 18941 bytes. Full-reveal proof (all 5 attrs): 5479 bytes. Real AnonCreds presentations fetched via /proof-data.

experiments.name: Selective disclosure latency cost
experiments.detail: Selective request→verified: 14576.2ms. Full-reveal request→verified: 8600.2ms. Positive value = selective disclosure cost more.

experiments.name: Selective disclosure payload reduction (attribute count only, no predicate)
experiments.detail: Selective proof, no predicate (3 attrs only): 5583 bytes. Full-reveal proof (all 5 attrs): 5479 bytes. Isolates attribute-count reduction from predicate cost.

experiments.name: Selective disclosure latency cost (attribute count only, no predicate)
experiments.detail: Selective (no predicate) request→verified: 6068.2ms. Full-reveal request→verified: 8600.2ms. Positive value = selective disclosure cost more.
